description:
Retrieve one monitor check and its page-level results, optionally filtered by page status. Pages report `same`, `new`, `changed`, `removed`, or `error`; configured goal judging can add a meaningful-change decision.

Markdown tracking returns a unified text diff, JSON tracking returns field paths with previous/current values and a current snapshot, and mixed tracking returns both. Returns one page of results plus a `next` URL when more pages exist.
name: firecrawl_monitor_check

outputSchema.description: One monitor check with its page-level diff results.

agent_hints.description: Optional response guidance from the Firecrawl API.

data.description: The check and its page-level results: each page reports `same`, `new`, `changed`, `removed`, or `error`, with diffs and any goal judgment.

error.description: Error message or error object when the call did not succeed.

next.description: URL of the next page of results, when more exist.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata for the page results.
